text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’m interested in your data entry operator role because I’m comfortable working in Excel and paying close attention to accuracy while handling structured data. My background is not just in reporting and analysis, but also in cleaning data, organizing information, and making sure files are easy to use and reliable. That combination helps when a project needs careful entry work, verification, and well-kept records.

One project I built was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I created one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. As a result, monthly close reporting was reduced from 3 days to 4 hours. This project required strong Excel work, data handling, and accuracy across multiple sources.

I also worked on a Parent survey analysis project for Riverbend Education Fund. I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings for the board. That project involved detailed data cleaning in Excel, careful review of responses, and presenting information clearly and accurately. The work led to 3 findings being adopted in the next funding plan.

For your job, I can help with Excel-based data entry, database updates, product listings, sales lead lists, and accuracy verification. I’m detail-oriented, organized, and used to working with data that needs to be dependable and easy to review. If needed, I can also help structure spreadsheets so they’re easier to maintain going forward.

Could you share what kind of Excel data you need entered or verified most often?
